title: Transitive Extensions of Automorphism Groups of Generic Structures
summary: This work addresses the existence of transitive extensions of certain infinite permutation groups which arise as the automorphism groups of model-theoretic structures which are generic in the Fraïssé sense. The study of transitive extensions has hitherto largely concerned itself with finite permutation groups.
